pkgmetadata.longdescription: Pyrrha is a Qt (PySide6) Pandora Radio client, a port of Pithos from GTK to Qt. It keeps Pithos' Pandora backend and GStreamer playback pipeline and ships the full set of Pithos plugins (MPRIS, media keys, notifications, tray icon, equalizer, Last.fm, screensaver inhibit/pause, volume normalization and journald logging).

use.flag: Enable logging to the systemd journal via dev-python/python-systemd
